g.text: Warehouse Management System - Domain, Service and Controller Classes
The state machine lives in the enum (allowedNext).
There is no separate strategy or factory class in the code.

+create(job : PickingJob, carrier : String, trackingNumber : String, method : ShippingMethod, expectedDeliveryDate : LocalDate) : Shipment

+updateStatus(shipmentId : Long, next : ShipmentStatus, location : String, note : String, occurredAt : LocalDateTime) : Shipment
+recordDelivery(shipmentId : Long, location : String, deliveredAt : LocalDateTime) : Shipment
+recordException(shipmentId : Long, location : String, reason : String) : Shipment
+recordReturn(shipmentId : Long, location : String, reason : String) : Shipment
